notes.title: Demo 2.4 update release (including bombs)
notes.notes:
Hello gamers,

Time for another small demo update! This one brings a number of tweaks and bombs! 

(I will be periodically updating this demo further, as I continue to build out the engine for the main game. So expect about one or two more versions before the end of the year)

------

[b]Changes in demo 2.4 (compared to v2.3):[/b]

[list]
[*] Added bombs (=found in a dungeon chest)
[*]     Stunned enemies now have a visual indicator
[*]     Small items from containers will now respawn after enough exploration (=this will require demo rebalancing down the line - feedback is welcome)
[*]     Tweaked the end credits screen + expanded the list of backer names
[*]     Fixed keys in chests in the demo dungeon not being displayed in the correct color
[*]     Replaced placeholder impact sprites with new custom assets
[*]     Reordered a few item menu items + updated a few descriptions slightly
[*]     Added proper water visuals while interacting with the water in the demo cave
[*]     Sword charging sparkles now better alignment with the sword while walking
[*]     Updated the darkness engine to account for more hero/enemy attacks (and Murray's flame)
[*]     Some of the elementals now also provide light in the dark
[*]     Updated the titlepage, splashscreen and file icon
[*]     Tweaked visuals small keys
[*]     Tweaked music volume levels
[*]     Fixed hit reflection sound potentially stacking
[*]     Fixed small visual oversight when doing a special sword attack in shallow water
[*]     Music volume is lowered during collection jingles
[*]     Made the regular shields a little more effective when facing up
[*]     Faster credits scroll speed has been increased
[*]     Fixed bug preventing accessing to one of the demo dungeon's secret chests
[*]     Fixed credits misalignment if displayed in fullscreen without screen stretching on
[*]     Lowered sound effect volume when using healing sprites while at full health/magic
[*]     Fixed a sporadically occurring demo subboss bug
[/list]

Happy gaming and till next time.

Greetings,
Martijn

notes.title: Successful Kickstarter and latest demo update
notes.notes:
Dear gamers,

[h2]The Horn of Balance Kickstarter has ended.[/h2]
[h1]And I can happily report that it was a success!![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792036/ed2a548a5453b20486048738fac9b4b5d399dfc3.png[/img]


You can read about the Kickstarter over here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hornofbalance/horn-of-balance?ref=discovery


There were several gameplay and lore reveals shared during the campaign so feel free to check out. And, if you're itching for more Zelda-like goodness: I also published several interviews with zeldalike fellow indie developers over there as well.



[h2]So, what's next for this project?[/h2]


[b]Development has been fully funded and is planned to conclude at the end of 2026.[/b]

While that may sound like a long wait, I do want to highlight that the final release will contain a massive 12 (!) large sized dungeons and 2 interconnected overworlds. This game is big, intricately designed and filled with secrets. So it WILL be well worth your time. (And for those that do not know: I'm essentially a solo developer with a daytime job on the side. So that also factors in).


[b]Expect more updates in the meantime[/b]

In fact, I have just recently updated the demo (as seen below) and continue with smaller periodic updates as the engine, world and backer rewards get completed.

And of course I'm occasionally sharing all sorts of teasers and development information over on Discord and Twitter/X, if you want to stay updated on the week to week progress.

------


[h1][b]Latest demo update:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*]     Made a few early demo puzzles slightly more intuitive
[*]     Outside signposts can no longer be destroyed with the sword (but can still be picked up)
[*]     Game now starts in full screen WITH screen stretching (upon first starting up the game), to accommodate modern widescreen monitors
[*]     Adjusted the “controls” menu pages to not show the run option until you collect the required option.
[*]     Added backers section to the credits page
[*]     Removed Kickstarter link from the menu
[*]     Tweaked animation of the wooden sword's special attack
[*]     Improved diagonal movement on stairs vs walls corner 
[*]     Controls now also displayed on the title page 

[*]     Implemented more new sound effects
[*]     Adjusted music volume per track
[*]     Tweaked demo dungeon key colours
[*]     Updated wall ceiling dithering style
[*]     Updated text on the final stats screen

[*]     Fixed typo in main item menu
[*]     Fixed collisions while running into hit switches / breakables
[*]     Fixed small tiling issue in demo dungeon
[*]     Fixed bug: boomerang not bouncing properly of some specific types of wall
[*]     Fixed bug: being able to trigger demo dungeon crash switch multiple times in sequence
[*]     Fixed bug: option to mirror HUD not working fully
[*]     Fixed bug: overlapping music when playing the credits from the start menu multiple times in a row
[*]     Fixed bug: able to clone some caught sprites if used when already at full hp/mp 
[/list]

That's it for now. Happy gaming and till next time.

Greetings,
Martijn
